semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company manufactures vacuum components and chambers essential for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Anadolu Ileri Uretim Teknolojileri A.S. specializes in the production of vacuum components and chambers, including high-quality HV and UHV components compliant with international standards. They cater to the semiconductor industry by supplying essential vacuum systems and components, primarily to European and Japanese markets.
capabilities: Manufacturing of high-quality vacuum chambers (cylindrical, cubic, hexagon, special designs)
Production of ISO-KF, ISO-CF, and UHV vacuum components
Custom design services for varied dimensions and applications

regional_presence.Europe: The company exports 90% of its products to Europe and Japan, indicating a strong presence in these markets.
